name: Myco Sprint XR
summary: MycoSprint is the world’s first mixed‑reality mushroom cultivation learning agricultural game. Designed for intuitive play, it lets you grow real mushroom species inside your physical space using simple XR interactions. Insert mycelium seeds, adjust temperature, humidity, and light, and watch your mushrooms respond in real time.
